notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome only, in my own tab; no HTTP client, proxy or reader was used. robots.txt (read in-tab) has one User-agent: * block disallowing only /warenkorb, /kundenkonto, /bestellung, /newsletter-einstellungen, /stoffmuster-, /konfigurator, /passwort/aendern and *.htm - no Claude / ClaudeBot / anthropic-ai directive and no category path blocked. No WAF, challenge or rate-limit appeared at roughly 1 request every 2.6s. TREE SOURCE: the server-rendered mega-menu on the homepage (#headerMenuContainer, one span.flyoutMenu per department: Moebel, Garten, Kueche, Haushalt, Bad, BettenMatratzen, Textilien, Buero, Lampen, Deko, Kinder, Inspiration), read via the DOM in the tab; all 12 departments were walked. Furniture lives in Moebel, Garten, Bad (Bad-Moebel), Buero, Kinder, BettenMatratzen (Betten plus Komplett-Schlafzimmer) and Kueche (Kuechenzeilen). Haushalt, Textilien, Deko, Lampen and Inspiration were inspected and hold no furniture. The mega-menu tree was then extended with each listing page's own sub-category strip (the first <section> inside #rootOfReactApp), which is where the additional real product-type nodes under Regale, Hocker, Baenke, Schraenke, Badschraenke and Gartenmoebel came from. QTY SOURCE: every qty is the rendered listing header 'N Ergebnisse', which Hoeffner ships server-rendered in the HTML of the category URL; each page was read with a same-origin fetch() from the loaded hoeffner.de tab. No structured/API totals were used anywhere. SANITY CHECKS: (1) live in-tab renders agreed with the same-origin reads exactly - /sofas showed '1251 Ergebnisse' and /raumteiler '12 Ergebnisse'; (2) full enumeration of /nachttische over /nachttische, /nachttische/2, /nachttische/3 and /nachttische/4 produced exactly 155 unique /artikel/<id> product ids against a reported 155 (page size 72), so the header count is exact, not inflated; (3) /raumteiler enumerated 12 unique product tiles against a reported 12; (4) counts vary per category (no constant site-wide number) and every h1 matched the node requested; (5) redirects were tracked - /aktenschraenke redirects to /bueroschraenke and /jugendsofas redirects to /jugendmoebel, so both were dropped as aliases rather than recorded twice; (6) /dielenschraenke and /garderobenschraenke both report 157, and a product-id comparison returned 72 ids on each page with a 72/72 intersection - the same listing under two slugs - so only Hallway Cabinets (/dielenschraenke) was kept. HIERARCHY: parents whose mega-menu children form the site's own breakdown (Sofas, Sessel, Stuehle, Hocker, Baenke, Betten, Tische, Schraenke, Kommoden & Sideboards, Regale, Gartenmoebel, Loungemoebel, Balkonmoebel, Badschraenke, Babyzimmer, Kinderzimmer, Jugendzimmer) are emitted as grouping rows with qty and link null. Desks and Office Chairs are emitted as leaves alongside their variants because the Moebel > Tische and Moebel > Stuehle menus present Schreibtische / Buerotische / Computertische and Buerostuehle as siblings rather than as a parent-child partition. Hoeffner's own categories overlap by design (e.g. 2-Sitzer vs Ledersofas vs Ecksofas) - these are the site's nodes, not derived splits, so no child count should be summed into a parent. EXCLUDED: colour / style / brand filter URLs (the /<cat>__<colour> and /<cat>_<brand> pattern) and attribute-refinement nodes (/ecksofas-mit-schlaffunktion, /kleiderschraenke-mit-spiegel, /esszimmerstuehle-mit-armlehnen, /kuechenbloecke-150-220 and similar); 'Alle ansehen', 'Alle <X>', 'Weitere Kategorien' and 'Mehr <X>' (/empfehlung-*) navigation links; Lagerraeumung (clearance); Beratung / Service / Inspiration / Ratgeber landing pages; and room landing pages (/wohnzimmer, /esszimmer, /schlafzimmer, /flur, /badezimmer). Out of scope by product type: all mattresses and mattress accessories (/matratzenart, /matratzen, /lattenroste), Bettwaren (bedding), all textiles (Teppiche, Gardinen, Rollos, Dekokissen), the whole Lampen department, Deko and Geschenkartikel, Haushalt (cookware, tableware, glassware, cutlery), Elektrogross- and Elektrokleingeraete (appliances), Aufbewahrung (standalone storage goods), garden non-furniture (Sonnenschirme, Ampelschirme, Schirmstaender, Pavillons, Auflagen & Kissen, Gartendekoration), and in the Bad department the fixtures and accessories (/sanitaer-armaturen, /badaccessoires, /wc-zubehoer, /badtextilien) plus /badezimmer-spiegel (bathroom mirrors, which belong to Wall Decor). Laufgitter (playpens) was dropped as baby equipment rather than furniture.
